alert_timing: Generated every Monday at 6:00 AM, covering the prior 7 days of activity

Red.action: Immediate outreach within 48 hours. Schedule 1-on-1 meeting with student.
Red.notification: Email + in-app banner + SMS to advisor

Amber.action: Flag for weekly review. Send supportive check-in email to student.

Green.action: No action required. Available in dashboard for reference.

alert_content: Top 3 contributing risk factors with plain-language explanation
Link to full student engagement profile
threshold_rationale: Alert threshold set at 36% to optimize for high recall (catching at-risk students) while maintaining acceptable precision (minimizing unnecessary outreach).
